attribution.reported_authority: Usha, S. 1992. Keralathile Aranadanmar (Aranadars of Kerala). Vijinana Kairali, Kerala Bhasha Institute, Trivandrum 23-8, August, 1992.
attribution.authority_scope: Chapter bibliography only. Usha is not stated to be the chapter author. No occurrence-level mapping or original-article collation is asserted.
attribution.authority_uncertainty: Retain the printed 23-8 string in a note rather than guessing a volume/issue interpretation.
attribution.licence: No explicit reuse licence established by this review; publisher availability is not an open-licence claim. Do not commit the full source PDF.

identity_routes.evidence: Chapter heading p9; existing registry record. Malayalam/Kannada similarities are comparisons, not a language merger.
Explicit comparison headings and parenthetical labels pp9–10.
p10 explicitly labelled niinu.Ka. comparator; retain source abbreviation in audit.

locality_policy: p9 Kerala/Tamil Nadu distribution and listed settlements describe the community. They do not establish separate lects or item-level elicitation sites. Preserve attributed distribution prose; no invented coordinates or site dialects.

notation.proposal: U+0323 COMBINING DOT BELOW on the preceding letter; NFC allowed with exact raw code retained
notation.evidence: p9 enlarged l/l/t/r controls show isolated round lower dots. p10 r comparisons corroborate. This is glyph preservation, not inferred retroflex or rhotic phonetic interpretation.

notation.proposal: U+0303 COMBINING TILDE on the preceding letter
notation.evidence: p9 enlarged e, n, a, a and o marks are visibly tildes. Preserve the n tilde and both a tildes in the I example; do not collapse doubled vowels.

notation.raw: initial n with a drawn underline, absent from extracted text
notation.proposal: n plus U+0332 COMBINING LOW LINE, with a source-typography note
notation.evidence: p10 second-person nin, parenthetical Kannada niinu, and three initial niin expression tokens show an underline beneath initial n. Do not map to ñ or ṇ. Later niina tokens lack that visible underline in the inspected crop; do not harmonize.
Source font text and original examples agree; no conversion to n or ng.

notation.proposal: retain doubled vowels and g in Original; do not impose IPA length marks or script-g conversion
notation.evidence: No chapter transcription key warrants modern IPA normalization.

notation.proposal: preserve literal slash grouping and printed hyphen/dash in audit; expand only independently reviewed explicit alternatives
notation.evidence: naaji/naayi and puje/puye are explicit alternatives; suffixes and missing leading hyphen in atu must not be silently regularized.

notation.raw: underlined l in Malayalam kooli/naali/pula, absent from extracted text
notation.proposal: l plus U+0332 COMBINING LOW LINE; keep distinct from dot-below l
notation.evidence: Independent original p9 image confirms a horizontal lower line beneath l in all three comparison cells. This is not the round dot below in the water/net controls.

source_claim_constraints: p10 explicitly denies an inclusive/exclusive contrast: naam denotes a large group and yem a small group. Do not add inclusive/exclusive tags.
p10 nominal plural suffix has an animate restriction in Aranadan, contrasted with Malayalam; retain both source-qualified claims.
p9 prose says the i of Malayalam becomes y or j. Preserve the printed claim and any example discrepancy rather than silently replacing the letter from linguistic expectation.
Community names and feature comparisons do not independently supply Paniya/Adiya lexical forms.
